1 غَنَظَهُ , aor.
غَنِظَ (S, O, K, TA) and
غَنُظَ , (TA,) inf. n. غَنْظٌ, (S, O, TA,) It, (an affair, or event, S, O, K, TA,) and he, (a man, O, TA,) distressed him. (S, O, K, TA.) And It, or he, filled him with wrath. (TA.) And It (anxiety) clave, or kept constantly, to him; as also ↓ اغنظهُ . (TA.) [See also غَنْظٌ below.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
